facts.text: The perspective of the project is what is happening in Mexico.
In the last year, the community in Mexico has been growing.
More people are involved in projects in Mexico.
More people are getting on board in Mexico.
Most people are walking with strong core values about the ecosystem.
Last year, there were two big events in Mexico: ETHMexico and Blockchainland.
ETHMexico was run by ETHGlobal.
Blockchainland was run by a private entity.
ETHMexico and Blockchainland each got more than 700 attendees.
This year, the only big confirmed blockchain event is BlockchainLand.
The Ethereum México Community Team believes the most important Web3 event should not be a private one.
The Ethereum México Community Team aims to make an event created by the community for the community.
The planned event will include workshops and talks.
The workshops and talks will cover how Ethereum and protocols built on it can bring new tools and opportunities for people.
